description: Adds Infobip email authentication and tracking DNS records for your Assistfinity sending domain.
variableDescription: %dkim_selector%: Infobip DKIM selector label without ._domainkey. %dkim_data%: full Infobip DKIM TXT value for that selector. %ib_prefix%: Infobip envelope or tracking host label under the sending host. %track_to%: Infobip tracking CNAME target. %env_to%: Infobip envelope CNAME target. %dmarc_to%: Infobip DMARC CNAME target.
